answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Only logit-level data are available. Top-1 agreement is 0.926 and sequence agreement is 0.547, both within the fine-tuned ranges (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64) and outside quantized (0.945-0.955, 0.67-0.70). KL is 0.080, at the low edge of fine-tuned (0.081-0.205) and above quantized (0.039-0.071). TV is 0.083, within fine-tuned (0.076-0.099). Token-DiFR gap is 0.243, within fine-tuned (0.10-0.31) and below system-prompted (0.28-0.52). Raw-score shift ÷ TV is 11.3, slightly above the fine-tuned maximum of 10.8 but far from the quantized (2.2-2.3) and system-prompted (3.3-3.9) ranges, so it fits fine-tuned best. System-prompted is ruled out because KL is below 0.197 and top-1 agreement is above 0.908. Quantized is ruled out by the lower agreement, higher KL, and the very high raw-score ratio. Base is ruled out because all differences are non-zero.
